_contract_note: Canonical versioned Loop Runtime Contract for 0.67.0 (FEAT-002, ADR-013). This file is the SINGLE source of truth for the v2 runtime payload shape. The writer (loop_migration), v2 validator (checks/flow_unit_runtime_v2.py), reader (loop_engine.rollup_loop_state), and health (loop_health) each load this schema and conform. The v1 visibility contract (schema_version 1.0) routes to the existing checks/flow_unit_runtime.validate_flow_unit_runtime_payload UNCHANGED — this file does not modify v1. RISK-037 and RISK-042 remain open: this contract does NOT activate any runtime execution engine (that is FEAT-005~007, 0.68.0).

_design_review_notes.F1_loop_state_shape: Design Review F1 (P2, non-blocking): the dormant writer today emits the 3-field FX-190 derive shape {active_loop, loop_count, last_loop_type}. The 9-field loop_state_fields list below is the v2 TARGET shape (set by FEAT-004 canonical initial state when a unit is activated). This is correct: v2 is the new shape, and the v2 validator requires all 9 fields present on every unit.
_design_review_notes.F2_sha_text_path: Design Review F2 (P2, non-blocking): the NFC-normalize-then-sha256 idiom this contract's consumers reuse lives at infra/checks/loop_runtime_claims.py:_sha_text (the full path includes the /checks/ segment). Any FEAT-003 plan-hash implementation should import/copy the idiom from there.
_design_review_notes.F3_plan_hash_basename: Design Review F3 (P2, non-blocking): migration_plan_hash is structural+basename identity, NOT full-path identity. project_id is derived from target_root basename, so two genuinely distinct projects that share a directory basename AND identical derived unit structure produce the same plan_hash. This is acceptable for the REL-059 dry-run/apply identity invariant (same target -> same hash is guaranteed) and is documented here so the no_overclaim boundary is not over-read as a full-path guarantee.

migration_plan_hash.note: 64-hex SHA-256 from FEAT-003 build_migration_plan. FEAT-002 validator checks presence + shape (64 lowercase hex); the re-derivation parity check is FEAT-003.

decomposition_confirmed.note: FEAT-004 hook: v2 payload may only be written if decomposition was confirmed. false/absent fails validation. FEAT-002 validator enforces this now.

no_overclaim_boundary.note: non-empty string list containing every mandatory token in no_overclaim_boundary_mandatory_tokens

derivation_reason.note: non-empty. The fallback single-unit reason is 'no-decomposable-structure-found' (explicit, never silent). The reserved token 'example-fixture' MUST pair with runtime_status 'dormant' (FEAT-004 AUDIT-133 guard).

loop_state.note: the 9-field FX-189 shape (see loop_state_fields), initialized per FEAT-004

gate_state.note: {status, gate_id, last_result, evidence_refs}; status from allowed_gate_statuses; gate_id is the current loop-role gate (G1-G11 mapped via loop_gate_semantics); last_result UNIFIED with loop_state.last_gate_result

runtime_status.note: one of allowed_runtime_statuses. FEAT-004 guard: active requires loop_state.active_loop:true; dormant requires active_loop:false (bidirectional implication, validator-enforced).

invariants.last_gate_result_unification: loop_state.last_gate_result MUST equal gate_state.last_result (the single gate result driving iterate-vs-escalate). FEAT-002 unification — validator-enforced.
invariants.runtime_status_active_loop_bidirectional: runtime_status:active IMPLIES loop_state.active_loop:true AND runtime_status:dormant IMPLIES loop_state.active_loop:false. Bidirectional implication; FEAT-004 guard against dormant-masquerading-as-active; validator-enforced in FEAT-002.
invariants.decomposition_confirmed_required: decomposition_confirmed MUST be true for a v2 payload. FEAT-004 hook enforced by the v2 validator in FEAT-002.
invariants.example_fixture_not_active: If derivation_reason is 'example-fixture' (reserved token), runtime_status MUST be 'dormant'. FEAT-004 AUDIT-133 guard; the v2 validator enforces it.

v1_compatibility.note: schema_version '1.0' (or absent) routes to the existing visibility-v1 validator UNCHANGED. The v1 validator is byte-frozen (the 0.52.0/0.66.1 containment boundary); FEAT-002 adds a version router at the entry point but does NOT modify validate_flow_unit_runtime_payload logic. Classic/dynamic installations keep producing v1; no installed v1 payload is invalidated.

no_overclaim_boundary: Loop Runtime Contract v2 is the canonical versioned contract schema for 0.67.0 (FEAT-002).
Loop Runtime Contract v2 does not activate execution engine; the persisted PARO state machine and production gate back-edge/fuse are FEAT-005~007 (0.68.0).
Loop Runtime Contract v2 does not close RISK-037; loop-engineering runtime activation remains scoped to contract + planner + initial state, not execution.
Loop Runtime Contract v2 does not close RISK-042; external effectiveness is not proven until 0.69.0 (VAL-008/VAL-009).
RISK-037 remains open until the 0.68.0 execution engine and 0.69.0 external validation are both complete.
RISK-042 remains open until 0.69.0 external validation (VAL-008/VAL-009).
Loop Runtime Contract v2 does not modify the v1 visibility validator (checks/flow_unit_runtime.py); v1 is byte-frozen as the 0.52.0/0.66.1 containment boundary.
Loop Runtime Contract v2 does not change the loop runtime claim scanner policy (ADR-011/012); new v2 surfaces comply with the existing claim contract at write time.
Loop Runtime Contract v2 does not claim 1.0.0 production-ready.
